title: Korean AI chip startup DEEPX, Hyundai work on robots powered by generative AI
title_zh: 韩国人工智能芯片初创公司 DEEPX 和现代汽车致力于开发由生成式人工智能驱动的机器人
summary: South Korean AI chip startup DEEPX will expand its partnership with Hyundai Motor Group to develop a computing platform for generative ‌AI robots using its second generation of low-power chips, its top executive said, as ‌it gets set for an IPO.
summary_zh: 韩国人工智能芯片初创公司 DEEPX 将扩大与现代汽车集团的合作伙伴关系，利用其第二代低功耗芯片为生成型人工智能机器人开发计算平台，该公司高管表示，该公司正准备进行 IPO。

title: Amazon’s $11.6 Billion Globalstar Deal Amps Up Musk Rivalry
title_zh: 亚马逊 116 亿美元的 Globalstar 交易加剧了马斯克的竞争
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Amazon.com Inc.’s $11.6 billion deal to buy Globalstar Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——亚马逊公司 (Amazon.com Inc.) 以 116 亿美元收购 Globalstar Inc.

title: Bessent Calls Anthropic’s Mythos a Breakthrough in China AI Race
title_zh: Bessent 称 Anthropic 的神话是中国人工智能竞赛的突破
summary: (Bloomberg) -- US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent hailed Anthropic PBC’s Mythos as a revolutionary step that will keep America ahead of China in AI, endorsing an industry leader that’s clashed with Washington over its role in military endeavors.Bessent, speaking Tuesday at a ...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 称赞 Anthropic PBC 的 Mythos 是革命性的一步，它将让美国在人工智能领域领先于中国，并支持一位在军事行动中与华盛顿发生冲突的行业领导者。贝森特周二在一次会议上发表讲话。

title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow futures hover amid renewed hopes for US-Iran talks
title_zh: 今日股市：标普 500 指数、纳斯达克指数和道琼斯指数期货徘徊在美伊谈判重燃希望之际
summary: Stock futures traded flat as banks report  profit increases with the Iran war weighing on market optimism.
summary_zh: 由于伊朗战争打压市场乐观情绪，银行报告利润增加，股指期货交易持平。

title: OpenAI investors question valuation after questionable pivot
title_zh: OpenAI 投资者在可疑的转向后质疑估值
summary: TECHnalysis Research, LLC, president Bob O'Donnell joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination Overtime to discuss OpenAI's (OPAI.PVT) big pivots ahead of its IPO that have investors scratching their heads.
summary_zh: TECHnaanalysis Research, LLC 总裁 Bob O'Donnell 与 Josh Lipton 一起在《Market Domination Overtime》中讨论了 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 在 IPO 之前的重大转变，这些转变让投资者摸...

title: Meta extends custom chips deal with Broadcom to power AI ambitions
title_zh: Meta 延长与博通的定制芯片协议，以推动人工智能的雄心
summary: Meta will work with chip designer Broadcom to produce several generations of custom artificial intelligence processors under an expanded deal ‌as the social media giant races to build out the computing ‌capacity needed to power AI features across its apps.
summary_zh: 随着社交媒体巨头竞相构建为其应用程序提供人工智能功能所需的计算能力，Meta 将与芯片设计商博通 (Broadcom) 合作，根据扩大的协议生产几代定制人工智能处理器。

title: OpenAI Releases Cyber Model to Limited Group in Race With Mythos
title_zh: OpenAI 向有限群体发布网络模型，与神话赛跑
summary: (Bloomberg) -- OpenAI is letting a select group of users access a new artificial intelligence model that’s meant to be more adept at spotting software security vulnerabilities, one week after rival Anthropic PBC announced a limited release of an AI tool called Mythos.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——在竞争对手 Anthropic PBC 宣布有限发布名为 Mythos 的人工智能工具一周后，OpenAI 正在让一组选定的用户访问一种新的人工智能模型，该模型更擅长发现软件安全漏洞。

title: Tesla stock upgraded, CarMax Q4 earnings disappoint Wall Street
title_zh: 特斯拉股票上调，CarMax 第四季度盈利令华尔街失望
summary: Yahoo Finance anchor Josh Lipton tracks Tuesday's top-moving stocks and biggest market stories. Tesla (TSLA) stock was upgraded to Neutral from Sell by UBS analysts. CarMax (KMX) stock is sinking after the company's fourth quarter earnings results disappointed Wall Street.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经主播乔什·利普顿追踪周二走势最强劲的股票和最大的市场故事。瑞银分析师将特斯拉 (TSLA) 股票的评级从“卖出”上调至“中性”。 CarMax (KMX) 的第四季度盈利结果令华尔街失望，该公司股价正在下跌。

title: D-Wave CEO says Nvidia should be 'shaking in their boots' as quantum computing battles AI GPUs
title_zh: D-Wave 首席执行官表示，随着量子计算与 AI GPU 的较量，Nvidia 应该“颤抖”
summary: D-Wave touts massive energy efficiency gains over Nvidia as World Quantum Day sparks a sector-wide rally.
summary_zh: 随着世界量子日引发整个行业的反弹，D-Wave 宣称其能源效率比 Nvidia 大幅提高。
